items.question: How does the Argon2 password hashing protect my builder?
items.answer: Argon2 is the winner of the Password Hashing Competition (PHC). It uses memory-hard functions that resist GPU and ASIC cracking attacks. When you log in, hash-wasm runs the cryptographic verification via WebAssembly right inside your browser!

items.question: Can I export the website to host on any server?
items.answer: Yes! AetherBuilder provides 1-click HTML & JSON export. You can download the static files and host them on Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel, AWS S3, or any standard Apache/Nginx web server.

items.question: Does the public view load quickly for visitors?
items.answer: Absolutely. The public view is stripped of all editor overhead. It renders lightweight, semantic HTML with CSS variables and lazy-loaded media for blazing 99+ Google Lighthouse scores.
